crossRefs.note: Thus Noah did. He did all that God commanded him.
Thus all the work of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting was finished. The children of Israel did according to all…
According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.
Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it as Yahweh had commanded. They had done so; and Moses blessed them.
Moses did so. According to all that Yahweh commanded him, so he did.
Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.
But Jesus, answering, said to him, “Allow it now, for this is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness.”…
But he answered them, “My mother and my brothers are these who hear the word of God, and do it.”
His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”
Jesus therefore said to them, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do…
He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn’t left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.”
If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.
And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.
though he was a Son, yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered.

people.name: Noah

translations.web: Noah did everything that Yahweh commanded him.
translations.bsb: And Noah did all that the LORD had commanded him.
translations.kjv: And Noah did according unto all that the LORD commanded
translations.asv: And Noah did according unto all that Jehovah commanded him.
